text.p: The following are the leading stories in the Maltese press on Friday. Reuters has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
- Industry survey calls for restructuring of the Malta Development Corporation to attract foreign investment.
- Planning Authority stops illegal quarrying works close to prehistoric temples.
- Nationalist Party challenges government's claim that when it was in power it had bought out private shareholders in Gozo Channel.
- Public Works Minister Charles Buhagiar said the financial situation at the Water Sevices corporation was so bad that banks were refusing to lend it money.
